## Details

<a id="radar_clear"></a>
### [`radar_clear`](../../../../src/radar/radar_52a0.asm#L6) `$52A0`

*routine*

Clears the radar characters $d0-$df to $aa and sets $e0-$ff to $aa/$55 stripes. Draws the centre line in characters $d7 and $e7.

- **Called from:** [`$4150`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L15), [`$4193`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L61)
- **Reads:** [`radar_mark_top`](../data/charset.md#radar_mark_top), [`radar_mark_bottom`](../data/charset.md#radar_mark_bottom)
- **Writes:** [`radar_chars`](../data/charset.md#radar_chars), [`radar_mark_top`](../data/charset.md#radar_mark_top), [`radar_mark_bottom`](../data/charset.md#radar_mark_bottom)
